name: Abdelrahman Ghareeb
bio: Founder of SEE, using video analytics to improve athletic performance. His talk explores what we can learn from what is missing.

name: Ahmed Samy
bio: Entrepreneur exploring resilience and experimentation. His talk considers how trying different paths can help us find our way.

name: Aida Shaaban
bio: Chef, food consultant and wellness coach exploring the connections between food, wellbeing, identity and healing.

name: Bassem Abdelmalek
bio: Founder of a father-and-child camp initiative. He explores engaged parenting and the value of being present.

name: Mostafa Adel
bio: Creator of The Audio Bus, exploring identity and reinvention through sound. His talk uses music to examine growth and fresh starts.

name: Mostafa Kamel
bio: Brand and marketing specialist and multidisciplinary creative exploring identity beyond labels and navigating personal and professional uncertainty.

name: Mostafa Salem
bio: Architectural designer and urban advocate exploring how better public spaces can transform communities and everyday life.

name: Rami Hamdi
bio: Writer questioning standardized beauty and curated digital ideals. His talk explores perception, authenticity and paying closer attention.

name: Amir Roushdy
bio: GUC mechatronics and robotics professor and ARAtronics director, connecting research, industry and human creativity through AI and robotics.

name: Haitham Gheita
bio: Sports mental coach and HG Mental Academy founder, helping athletes across many sports develop their mental performance.

name: Manal Olama
bio: Egyptian Clothing Bank CEO and Almah founder, working in sustainable fashion, circular production and community support.

name: Mohamed Ehab
bio: Entrepreneur at Entlaq Holding with experience in mobility and robotics, a GUC engineering background and international squash competition.

name: Sherif El Sayed
bio: Graphic designer and junior art director exploring how first and second languages influence emotions and society.

name: Sohaila Omar
bio: Ancient Egyptian archaeology researcher, author and content creator sharing museum stories and Egyptian heritage.

name: Yara Hesham
bio: Archstudios founder and architecture graduate with interests in urban design, social media management and content creation.

name: Yassin Mahgoub
bio: Medical graduate and animal advocate sharing experiences in medicine, volunteering and everyday life through humorous and motivational content.

name: Ahmed El Helaly
bio: Life coach and NLP practitioner who moved from commerce into coaching and training, with involvement in ICF Egypt.

name: Alaa El Masry
bio: Learning difficulties and disabilities teacher studying psychology, and founder of Peace of Heart, a disability-awareness platform.

name: Dibo
bio: Film and commercial director with an international strategy background, bringing travel, storytelling and imaginative world-building into filmmaking.

name: Ibrahim Ahmed
bio: Psychologist, school counselor and content creator examining criminal behavior, forensic research and body language.

name: Mahmoud Hawary
bio: Art director, documentary filmmaker and visual artist, and founder of Humans of Upper Egypt.

name: Rania Abdelaziz
bio: Speech and language specialist and advanced DIRFloortime provider supporting children and families through child-led practice and parent coaching.

name: Rowan El Selmy
bio: WeAreDesco co-founder, architect and teaching assistant exploring computational design, AI and metaverse design.

name: Shereen Rizk
bio: Family and business constellation facilitator, Enneagram teacher and Reiki practitioner offering workshops on personal and professional dynamics.

name: Yahya Hefnawi
bio: Computer engineering student at the Technical University of Munich and Apple intern, interested in AI and its real-world impact.

name: Youssef El Akkari
bio: Growth marketing consultant and podcast host with experience in digital advertising, automation, funnels and international brand work.

name: Menna El Naggar
talk_title: The Human Experience: Stories That Heal, Inspire and Transform
bio: The creative force behind Artiffied, Menna explores art not just as a form of expression, but as a core pillar of how we experience the world.

name: Nancy Maher
talk_title: The Pillars Within: Simulated Connection, Real Disconnection
bio: A Professional Certified Coach (PCC) accredited by the International Coaching Federation, certified life & relationship coach, and NLP practitioner. With a strong academic background in Pharmaceutical Chemistry and Business Administration from GUC, she bridges science and personal development.

name: Moaz Akram
talk_title: The Points You Never Knew You Were Scoring
bio: A professional modern pentathlete with 12 years of experience, a national medalist, and a podium finisher at the 2024 World Championship. He is also a fitness and fencing coach dedicated to building physical strength and mental toughness in others.

name: Gohar Said
talk_title: Entrepreneurship's Silent Battles: The Unfiltered Truth
bio: An innovative mind behind Suplyd and Maine. With a background in engineering and a sharp eye for solving real-world problems, he builds startups that transform industries and challenge how we think about innovation and leadership.

name: Roberto Joseph
bio: A digital multi-talented creator who has worked as a software engineer in Dubai, founded SwiftJobs, and served as the Cross-Platform Lead at Ernest in Miami. He channels his expertise into creating disruptive, authentic tech content on TikTok as @techwruby
